question: When can one temporary +Y rotation evidence the nested-cylinder/shoulder relation in an axis-relative frame?

measurement.scope: temporary +Y rigid rotation of the M32 two-cylinder construction
measurement.matched: Exactly two +Y coaxial cylinders with ordered radii share one planar shoulder.
measurement.fail_closed: Non-+Y axes, non-coaxiality, missing shoulder, different cardinality and global-XY substitution are unsupported.

supporting_cases: temporary +Y rigid rotation of M32 construction

boundaries: Only one +Y temporary control is supported; arbitrary orientation is unverified.
This is a geometry relation, not a feature label or history claim.

runtime_projection.review_trigger: Independent direct runtime evidence and a separate adoption review are required.
